subject: Deep context profile & budget range — follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@novacorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deep context profile & budget range — follow-up

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation on how NovaCorp plans to use an LLM for enriched product summaries and long-document Q&A. Per our call I pulled together the context / output profiling you asked for and a few pricing anchors so we can align next steps. See the quick recap below and the attached samples.

Call recap (short):
- Primary workload: interactive product-summary assistant (users upload product specs + docs; agent synthesizes answers).
- Expected primary context requirement: 32k windows for live sessions (~70% of requests).
- Occasional heavy analysis for batch imports that need full-document search/answering: 128k windows (~5% of requests).
- Remaining sessions fit comfortably in 8k windows (~25%).

Profile estimates (from your notes + our heuristics):
- Avg prompt tokens (includes user text + relevant system/context): ~420 tokens
- Avg completion tokens (answer length): ~1,250 tokens
- Avg tokens per request: ~1,670 tokens

Preliminary monthly volume scenarios (please confirm):
- Low: 10M tokens/month
- Expected: 120M tokens/month
- High: 500M tokens/month

Unit-econ target you mentioned on the call: $9–$12 per 1M tokens. For context, typical Redwood advertised anchors are: Hosted mixed workload ~ $18/1M (no commit), Dedicated committed pricing can be ~ $9–$11/1M depending on term & model variant. Quantized model variants and batching/caching can reduce per-token costs by 15–30% for steady state traffic.

Attachments I dropped with this email:
- context_samples.csv (sample user prompts & doc sizes)
- initial_usage_estimate.xlsx (simple monthly volume buckets)

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the expected monthly token range (low / expected / high) and whether the $/1M target of $9–$12 is flexible.
2) Share 2–3 representative prompt examples (or confirm attached csv covers it).
3) Would you like a short technical deep dive next week to validate 128k performance characteristics? We can spin a temporary eval cluster and run a small batch.

If you confirm the volumes and budget range, I’ll put Karthik (SE) and Marissa (Solutions) on a pricing + architecture email so we can model Hosted vs Dedicated options and a recommended pilot.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Sean,

Appreciate the fast recap — this looks right based on what we discussed. A few clarifications from my side:

- Budget: our procurement team is aiming for $9–$12 per 1M tokens as a target; if we can get pilot/POC pricing in that band we'll be in good shape to recommend moving forward to legal/procurement.
- Volumes: the 120M/month expected is a reasonable midpoint; we expect a growth ramp over 6–9 months from ~40–150M/month depending on adoption.
- Context: 32k will be our day-to-day. 128k will be used for large batch ingestion + analytics and will not be more than ~5–8% of monthly requests.
- Peak concurrency: during inside-the-product usage we estimate ~120 concurrent sessions at peak; sustained burst concurrency might hit ~300 for short windows (60–120s).

I attached a lightweight product brief and a sample consent/legal contact for the procurement thread (prod_brief.pdf). Happy to set a technical deep dive for next Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Alex Mercer
Head of AI Product | NovaCorp
alex@novacorp.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Alex / Sean — thanks, short pricing sketch below (preliminary, pending contract/legal + final model choice):

Pricing anchors (mixed 8k/32k/occasional 128k profile):
- Hosted (no commit): $20 / 1M tokens (baseline for mixed workload; includes managed infra & standard caching).
- Dedicated (12-mo term, committed capacity): $9 / 1M tokens at 300M+ committed monthly throughput equivalent (negotiable on term & model).
- Mid-tier commit (150M/mo): $11 / 1M tokens with ramp credits in month 1–3.

Discount levers to hit $9–$12 target:
- 12–24 month commitment + committed throughput (we can reach $9–$10/1M at 300M+/mo).
- Model selection: using a quantized variant (8-bit or 4-bit) for the summary task can reduce inference costs by ~15–25% without major quality drop for short answers.
- Operational: batching + prefix caching for repeated queries will reduce effective tokens billed by ~8–12% for your repeat-query patterns.

Pilot offer idea: 90-day pilot with up to 50M tokens of discounted usage (hosted) + a week-long 128k perf window test on a scheduled dedicated eval cluster; outcomes to determine final capacity sizing.

Notes/assumptions:
- Pricing above assumes standard Redwood models (v2 family) and typical tokenization. If you prefer a different open model we can re-run the cost sims.
- Networking / VPC/private deployment needs might add infra fees for Private deployment (if you require on-prem or VPC connectors).

Next actions I can take this week:
1) Put the three-tier cost model in a spreadsheet and share (will include per-1M breakdown, monthly total, and effective $/1M after discounts).
2) Schedule the 128k perf run once you confirm sample prompts & availability.
3) Draft a pilot term summary for legal/procurement to review.
